text:
dan (product): Quick thread: Stripe-like customer asked for per-account darklaunch for a new summarizer. Requirements: admin opt-in, weighted A/B for quality signals, per-account cost guardrails, and auditable exports for finance/privacy. Need a rollout plan we can show them.

ali (eng): Implementation path: use existing feature-flagging with account->variant map plus percent weights. We'll add a small header billing_tag for shadow vs billed. Cache scoping per-account is critical.

chris (sre): Ops gates proposed: sample_quality_score (auto eval) not worse by >2 pts, latency_p95 <= +30ms, token_cost_per_minute <= +20%. If any gate trips for that account -> immediate variant flip back and pause for 1h. Also need synthetic checks during shadow.

mel (sales): Customer timeline = 3 weeks. They want a short non-technical playbook for their admins: how to opt-in, how to pause, and who to call. Also ask for CSV export: timestamp, account_id, variant, tokens, billing_tag.

tori (privacy): Export must hash user IDs and strip PII. We need consent recorded in the contract addendum. Retention 90 days.

ali (eng): Minimal rollout: 1) shadow 48h (billing_tag=shadow) with traces, 2) weighted A/B (5% new billed, 95% baseline) for quality eval (10k samples), 3) canary 10% billed, 4) ramp 50% -> 100%. We'll include a hard-fallback API to flip an account back to baseline instantly.

chris (sre): Recommend two rollback modes: soft (route new requests to baseline, keep metrics) and hard (route + set billing_tag=hold). Hard requires billing pipeline to respect hold flag. We'll mock manual CSV if billing change delayed.

dan (product): Product decision: ship templated manual workflow + runbook now. Track ops hours for first two customers; if >X hours/customer, prioritize GA per-account routing.

ali (eng): Dev tasks: flag template, billing_tag header, cache scoping note, hard-fallback API. Estimate minimal path 6-8 dev-days if billing team signs off.

chris (sre): Ops tasks: runbook, dashboard queries for per-account gates, PD escalation for hard fallback. I'll prototype queries and synthetic job.

mel (sales): I'll gather account IDs and compliance contact. Customer accepts manual CSV for first run if needed. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: CI: feature-flag branch tests passed. No infra blockers reported.

dan (product): Action items: Ali PRD + sample flag config by EOD tomorrow; Chris runbook + alert queries in 48h; Tori draft export/consent wording in 72h; Mel collect account IDs this week. We'll reconvene after PRD review. Keep updates here.
